# Assessment Facts Overview

Supplementary documents generated from the Service Fabric deployment assets. Application source code is outside this assessment scope; each document notes where deployment metadata does not establish application behavior.

- [Architecture Diagram](architecture-diagram.md) — Service Fabric application, container, endpoint, and declared SQL connection relationships.
- [Dependency Map](dependency-map.md) — Package declarations available in the legacy deployment project manifests and their coverage limits.
- [API & Service Communication Contracts](api-service-contracts.md) — Declared service ports and configured SQL target; application routes and contracts are not available.
- [Data Architecture & Persistence Layer](data-architecture.md) — SQL container and configured database target; schema and data-access source are unavailable.
- [Configuration & Externalized Settings Inventory](configuration-inventory.md) — Deployment parameters, runtime settings, profiles, and redacted sensitive configuration.
- [Core Business Workflows](business-workflows.md) — Deployment connectivity flow and the limits of business-process analysis from deployment files.
